entities.name: spec/rules.md
entities.description: The specification document that establishes the 2500-line cap on the rules set and explains the reasoning behind it.

entities.name: Henri
entities.description: The author and keeper of the method who sets and approves changes to the rules cap and other governance decisions.

entities.name: board/README.md
entities.description: One of the five rule documents; describes how a task is worked and contains status information like blocked tasks.

entities.name: manifesto.md
entities.description: One of the five rule documents; describes how an instrument fails.

entities.name: spec/author.md
entities.description: One of the five rule documents; specifies what the author spends attention on.

entities.name: doc/instruments.md
entities.description: One of the five rule documents; describes what a session already has to work with.

entities.name: vision.md
entities.description: One of the five rule documents; describes what the method is for.

entities.name: tools/rulecount.py
entities.description: Python tool that counts the lines in the five rule documents and prints the total and remaining room.

entities.name: tools/suite.py
entities.description: Tool that puts the rule count on test/gates.md and prints it at every commit through a hook, displaying as a row or red section.

entities.name: card:working-standard.md
entities.description: Card that owns getting the rule count under the cap and records known fat like restatement.

entities.name: card:memory-atrophy.md
entities.description: Card that explains the keeper's reason for the cap: a method he could recite is worth more than a longer one he can search.

entities.name: journal.md
entities.description: The open month journal plus index; session narration and method evolution are recorded here rather than in rule documents.

entities.name: doc/memory/
entities.description: Directory containing the bodies of the memory corpus, which are spec-shaped and cost nothing until opened.

entities.name: MEMORY.md
entities.description: Private memory index read by sessions before they know what they are working on; 29 lines holding hooks for the memory corpus.

entities.name: test/gates.md
entities.description: Document where the rule count is displayed as a row when under cap or red section when over.

entities.name: test/test_rules.py
entities.description: Test that refuses loss of one of the five rule documents and tests that the lamp itself can light.

entities.name: test/test_journal.py
entities.description: Test that checks the journal index is generated and searches the open month and archive as one corpus.

entities.name: test/test_citations.py
entities.description: Test that searches journal citations across the open month and archive as one corpus.

entities.name: tools/journalroll.py
entities.description: Tool that rotates the journal, generates the index, and manages the transition from open to closed months.

entities.name: tools/seedaudit.py
entities.description: Tool that names board/README.md and spec/author.md and refuses their loss.

entities.name: journal/YYYY-MM.md
entities.description: Closed month archive files that are append-only and never edited again.

entities.name: keeper.md
entities.description: Document describing the keeper's evening standard work, which includes journal rotation as its fifth act.

entities.name: spec/sandbox.md
entities.description: Specification document that applies the rule that a cap not measured is a mood.

entities.name: doc/notes/
entities.description: Directory whose name for the five rule documents as 'method files' carried a false assumption and is retired.
